title: BlackRoad CarKeys Permission Lane
description: Canonical record for one of the 16 CarKeys permission lanes. Registry/carkeys.json is the single source of truth; the CARKEYS_LANES array in index.html is generated from it via scripts/sync-collections.mjs.

status.description: Honest gate status. 'locked' = no real auth in this UI.

risk.description: Risk tier for the lane (e.g. low/medium/high).

grants.description: Seed grants; the desktop mutates an in-memory copy at runtime.
